image_description: A vintage green Olympia typewriter sits on a wooden desk. The image features the full keyboard, carriage, and body of the typewriter. In the background, there are framed pictures/posters and a box of 'Ritter Sport' chocolate. To the left, there is a glass inkwell or paperweight.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Visually, the space bar is significantly wider than the round type keys above it, consistent with typewriter proportions.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the 'Ritter Sport' box and the framed images in the background is distorted and illegible, a common AI artifact where text rendering fails despite recognizable logos/shapes.

The mechanical parts above the platen (carriage return lever, ribbon spools) appear fused and lack clear logical connectivity. The geometry is 'mushy' and doesn't align with real-world typewriter mechanics.
The round keys show slight inconsistencies in perspective alignment; some ellipses don't match the vanishing point of the keyboard deck perfectly.
